notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.30c
notes.content:
This is a minor update that addresses some issues:
[olist]
[*] custom music in mod tracks should work for all players in online multiplayer now
[*] performance issues with the multiplayer lobby after playing a race should be fixed now
[*] mod tracks can now elect to allow endurance mode or disallow it using a setting in info.cfg for the track
[*] when choosing custom colors for a car, the darkest of the selected colors is used for the car's number now to improve readability
[*] improved the UI for the track select page when there are lots of options (the dots become a simple X/Y page indicator)
[/olist]

notes.title: Mod tracks go multiplayer, add leaderboards and more!
notes.content:
This update to PGRC makes mod tracks more competitive, and enables new track types. Here are the main changes:

Mod tracks now have leaderboards and ghosts, just like the main tracks.

Mod tracks can now be played in online and local split-screen multiplayer.

Mod tracks can now be point-to-point tracks (no laps), like... actual RALLY races :)

Mod tracks can now have branching paths including support for separate checkpoints along different routes.

Thank you for your continued support of PGRC, I hope you enjoy this update.  We are still working on an official expansion set of 8 new tracks set in western Europe as well, so look forward to that too!

A note to track creators: new documentation is coming for these new features ASAP.  Also please take a look at the documentation about track version numbers, leaderboards put some restrictions on the number of times you can revice your track and reset the scores.

notes.title: Custom Tracks are here!
notes.content:
"Another big update for PGRC has just arrived.  We have been working on adding mod support to the game, and today the first part is now available:  Custom track mods are now live, using Steam Workshop!

Players can now create their own custom tracks (using external mod tools), and share them with other players using Steam Workshop.  Some early testers have already made some amazing tracks.

This is just the beginning for mod support, more features for custom tracks, including support for leaderboards and playing custom tracks in multiplayer is planned, along with the ability to add custom cars into the game as well.

If you are interested in making your own tracks for the game, you can learn more [url=https://discord.gg/walaber]on the Walaber discord[/url] or directly at the [url=https://walaber-ent.github.io/pgrc-mod/overview/]Modding Documentation[/url] page."

notes.title: Workshop coming soon
notes.content:
You may have noticed that the Steam Workshop for Parking Garage Rally Circuit is now visible, with some custom made tracks starting to show up.  This is because Workshop support for game mods (custom tracks) is now in beta testing!

I hope to release an update with workshop support very soon.  If you're interested in [i]creating your own tracks[/i] for the game, you can learn more [url=https://walaber-ent.github.io/pgrc-mod/overview/]at this link[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/walaber]on my discord[/url]

notes.title: MacOS Support + Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update brings Parking Garage Rally Circuit to version 1.11a.

The biggest change in this version is the [b]addition of MacOS support[/b] for the game!  If you try the game out on Mac, please let me know if you run into any issues with the game!

Otherwise this update has some minor bug fixes reported by the community:
[olist]
[*] fixed issues with changing scale from small car cheat in multiplayer lobbies
[*] removed the red debug line on luggage cars in Seattle
[*] split screen lobby fix for liveries and colors on cheat cars fixed
[*] restarting race while results music is playing stops music now to ensure in-race music plays
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.10f patch notes
notes.content:
This is a minor update with some smaller fixes:
[list]
[*] added a setting for ghost opacity, you can adjust ghost opacity between 100%, 75%, 50% (default), 25%, and 10% values.
[*] fixed the setting menu being unresponsive when opened while spectating a leaderboard ghost
[*] implemented a maximum replay recording duration of 10 minutes to get rid of crashes when you play in a track for too long and the replay overflows
[*] back-to-wheels forces are reduced now when using the Tiny Cars cheat
[*] hiding the little blue panel on car select and track select when the prompt it contains is hidden
[*] controls sliders show the correct % value when the controls screen loads now
[/list]

notes.title: Split-screen is here (and more)
notes.content:
This update is a big one!  It adds local split-screen multiplayer for 2-4 players, among several other improvements!  List of changes below.

[olist]
[*] Split-screen multiplayer for 2-4 players.  One player can use the keyboard, the rest need a connected game controller.  Lots of options including contact (collisions) between players can be enabled.
[*] Cheat code revamp - cheat codes are now remembered once they have been entered once, and there is a new menu for easily toggling discovered cheat codes on/off.
[*] Race restart music behavior option: you can now let the music keep playing when you restart a race, instead of it starting over from the beginning over and over.
[*] Added controller prompt images for PS5 (Dual sense) controllers.
[*] Added an option to specify a specific controller to use for navigating the user interface (defaults to "any connected").  This might help with "double input" issues when using Steam Input or other similar software.
[*] Online multiplayer fixes: cheat codes can be changed in the lobby by the host.  Friend lobbies can be properly found and joined now.
[/olist]

notes.title: Coming soon: Split-Screen!
notes.content:
The next update to Parking Garage Rally Circuit will add split-screen multiplayer to the game, for 2-4 local players!

This update will also feature some other bug fixes and improvements as well.

I'm still working on the feature but it's coming along very nicely!  You can see day-to-day updates on my [url=https://x.com/walaber]twitter [/url]or tune into my [url=https://twitch.tv/walaber]live gamedev streams on twitch[/url] where I'm actively working on this!

notes.title: 文字化け修正 (fixed some Japanese text)
notes.content:
一部のテキストにはフォントが表示できない漢字があったことを修正いたしました！
This is a minor patch that fixes some Japanese characters that were not supported by the game's font.

notes.title: Achievement fixes and race ghost caching
notes.content:
I have just released version 1.03 which patches several bugs:
[list]
[*] When you quick-restart a race, or restart from the pause menu, or restart from results but without setting a new best time, ghosts are simply re-used instead of re-downloaded!  This should generally make the game way less over-enthusiastic about constantly re-downloading the same ghosts over and over.
[*] many achievements are re-checked on the progress overview screen now
[*] the long-standing "bronze trophies seem to follow silver trophies" bug has been fixed!
[*] quick restart during the attract mode "exploit" (which was kinda cute but buggy) has been properly disabled now :)
[/list]

As usual please let me know if you have issues with the game and I will do my best to address them!  The best place to do this is [url=https://discord.gg/walaber]on my discord[/url]

notes.title: Small but impactful multiplayer change, and crash fixes!
notes.content:
Another small patch, this brings the game to v1.02a.  This should make finding and joining multiplayer lobbies much easier (more detail below), and crashes related to the cheat cars have also been fixed.

Full details:
Previously, when a lobby went into a race, the lobby was marked as unjoinable.  This meant that if you checked multiplayer, you would often see no lobbies even though people were playing (they were just in a race).  Now, even when mid-race, the lobby remains open and new players can join and wait in the lobby for the next race.  When you are waiting in the lobby you will see some updates in the chat log as players finish the current race.  I hope this helps people find matches more easily! 

There was also a nasty crash bug related to a certain cheat code car, its ghost was too powerful, and whenever the ghost was loaded it crashed the game.  This has been fixed, and the cheat cars and leaderboard ghosts should work properly without crashing now!

If you find any bugs or have other feedback for the game, please let me know about it, either in the discussions here on Steam, or better yet in my [url=https://discord.gg/walaber]discord[/url], where I have a channel specifically for bugs and feedback, which makes things easier for me to track!

notes.title: Day 1 bug fixes are here!
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has been playing and enjoying the game in it's first few days of being released!  I have fixed a bunch of bugs that popped up on day 1, here's a short list of what's fixed:

[list]
[*] chat in multiplayer no longer tries to "localize" what you type (fr -> FRANÇAIS bug)
[*] non-US keyboard layouts showing the wrong key prompt fix
[*] fixed bug where restarting a race with specific timing could lead to the car being stuck at the start line
[*] fixed loss of audio when playing after using the spectate feature
[*] increased the default music volume to match the other audio volumes
[*] fixed issues where locked cars could appear dark in the attract/demo mode
[*] turned around the rogue arrow blocks on liberty island
[*] fixed exploit where using the leaderboard "challenge" feature allowed access to locked tracks
[*] removed the ability to switch tracks while viewing the leaderboard, which caused problems
[*] made the game grab and lock the mouse less
[*] made sure that when spectating ghosts, they aren't hidden
[*] resetting cheats while in a race should no longer cause restart to take you to the wrong track/car
[/list]

notes.title: Steamdeck Compatibility
notes.content:
We have been testing Parking Garage Rally Circuit regularly on Steam Deck, and believe the game is 100% compatible, and plays fantastic on the device! 

Please use the comments on this event to let us know your experience with the game on Steam Deck.
